report: A 21-month-old male with penile enlargement, hyperpigmentation, acne, hypertension, and an affected sibling shows markedly elevated ACTH (507), low cortisol (44), and high 17-hydroxyprogesterone (67), DOC (319), androstenedione (11). This pattern, especially the very high DOC, confirms congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 11β-hydroxylase deficiency, explaining virilization and hypertension and refuting adrenal virilizing tumor and central precocious puberty; the peripheral precocious puberty reflects secondary adrenal androgen excess. Confirmatory sequencing/imaging are pending.
